job_bartender._note: Weekly report line for a bartender.
_default: {name} kept the drinks flowing at {house} and settled two arguments with a single raised eyebrow.
{name} invented a new cocktail this week. Half the regulars love it, the other half are scared of it.
{name} worked the bar all week and knows every regular's order by heart now.
{name} polished glasses until they sparkled and served a gruff old sailor who confessed everything. The bar at {house} heard it all.
{name} worked behind the bar of {house} all week, pouring, laughing, and quietly cutting off a very determined merchant.
{name} learned the exact hour that the crowd wants something stronger, and had it ready each time.
A busy week at the bar: {name} juggled three orders at once and still remembered to ask after a regular's cough.
{name} added a pinch of cinnamon to the house wine and had {house} talking about it for days.
{name} turned a dull Tuesday around by sliding free peanuts across the bar and telling a truly terrible joke.

job_dancer._note: Weekly report line for a dancer.
_default: {name}'s new routine had the lounge on its feet.
{name} danced every night this week. Someone threw flowers, which she pretended not to love.
A crowd gathered early for {name}'s set. The bar did well out of it.
{name} danced in the lamplight until her bells jingled, and the room kept time with its feet.
The fiddler struggled to keep up with {name} this week. Nobody minded.
{name} spun through the lounge in silk and shadows, and a few clients forgot to drink.
{name} added a slow, swaying number to her set and the whole room went quiet before it erupted in applause.
Her ankles ached by Friday, but {name} gave the crowd a finale that brought the house down.
{name} dragged a shy client onto the floor for one dance. He talked about it for the rest of the evening.

job_bath._note: Weekly report line for a bath attendant.
_default: {name} kept the baths hot and the guests relaxed.
{name} has the guests so relaxed they forget to leave. She considers it a professional achievement.
Steam, scented oil, and {name}'s soft humming. The bathhouse was busy all week.
{name} kept the water hot and the lanterns low, and the guests drifted out pink and sleepy.
{name} swept steam off the tiles all week and learned to tell a tired merchant from a lonely one by the way he sank into the water.
Fresh towels, cedar oil, and {name}'s quiet humming: the bathhouse had a very good week.
{name} tended the baths and hung herbs from the rafters, which made the whole room smell like a mountain meadow.
The soaking tubs were full every night. {name} says it's the best job she's ever had for her hands.
{name} had the pool so cozy that two guests fell asleep in the water and had to be woken gently.

job_bath_joined._note: Bath attendant comfortable enough to join bathers in the water (bath massage).
_default: {name} didn't just tend the baths this week; she got in. Bath massages, in the water, became the most requested thing on the menu.
{name} spent most of the week in the hot water with the guests, working out knots. Nobody wanted to leave the pool.
Steam, scented oil, and {name} slipping into the water to give massages where they soak. Business was very good.
{name} slipped into the warm water with her sleeves rolled and spent the week kneading shoulders. The steam swallowed every sigh.
{name} traded her towels for a seat in the bath, working knots out of tired backs while lanterns swayed above. The queue was long.
{name} spent the evenings waist-deep in the pool, hands busy and the room fragrant with oil. Guests left looking boneless.
Bath massages from {name}, in the water, with cedar smoke and soft chatter. She says her hands are sore and her heart is full.
{name} dunked herself into the baths each night, and the guests have been tipping like it's a festival.
{name} waded in among the soaking guests this week, and the most-requested spot in the whole house became the one next to her.

job_bath_more._note: Bath attendant who joined bathers and, in the mood, offered them more.
_default: {name} joined the bathers in the water, and once or twice the massage turned into something more, at her suggestion.
Bath massages in the water all week, and {name} was in such a mood that a few lucky guests got more than their backs worked on.
The baths were busy and so was {name}. When the mood took her, the massages didn't stay massages.
{name} slid into the water for massages as usual, but a few times her hands wandered where she meant them to.
The steam was thick, the oil was warm, and {name} was feeling bold. Not every massage stayed innocent.
{name} worked out the knots in tired shoulders, and sometimes the kneading turned into something slower and warmer.
Between the lanterns and the humid hush, {name} let a few of her massages drift further than the menu allows.
{name} treated a few of her favorites to a little extra under the water, and no one was in the mood to complain.
The baths were busy, and so was {name}. A few lucky guests got a massage that ended in a quiet, shared smile.

job_teacher._note: Weekly report line for the classroom teacher.
_default: {name} ran the classroom at {house} with a ruler and endless patience. Notes were taken.
{name} drilled the house until the lesson stuck. Somebody asked for homework. {name} was delighted.
{name} wrote on the slate, pointed, and waited. By evening the whole house was practising.
{name} chalked the day's lesson across the slate at {house} and ran the class with a patient, level voice.
{name} gave the ladies of {house} a hard morning of drills and an easy afternoon of practice.
{name} corrected posture, vowels, and bad habits with a gentle tap of her pointer. By Friday the house was gliding.
{name} turned the classroom of {house} into the liveliest room in the building. Somebody asked for extra lessons.
{name} taught a pupil one tiny trick this week and watched it spread through the house like wildfire.
{name} filled the slate at {house} with diagrams, jokes, and a stern reminder to keep up.

job_maid._note: Weekly report line for a maid.
_default: {name} scrubbed {house} until it shone. Guests noticed.
{name} found three lost earrings, a sword, and a love letter while cleaning. She returned all of them.
{name} reorganized the linen closet. Nobody asked her to. Everybody's grateful.
{name} beat the rugs, dusted every shelf, and scrubbed the floors of {house} until the whole place smelled of lemon soap.
{name} washed the windows of {house} until the lantern light came through gold.
{name} changed every set of sheets by Wednesday and swept up a surprising amount of rose petals.
{name} polished the banister, the brasses, and the mirror in the lounge. Several guests checked their hair in it.
{name} worked from dawn to dusk making {house} sparkle, and hummed the whole time.
{name} cleaned out the cellar of {house}, found a crate of forgotten wine, and gave it to Sam with a straight face.
{name} walked a drunk adventurer to the door without him even noticing he'd been thrown out.
A quiet week on watch for {name}. She suspects her reputation is doing half the work.
{name} stood by the door looking unimpressed all week. It worked.
{name} leaned against the door frame all week with her arms folded, and trouble thought twice.
A rowdy crowd tested the door on Saturday. {name} stared at them quietly until they went home.
{name} walked the corridors every hour and checked every latch twice. Nothing happened, which was the point.
{name} spent the week watching the street from the front step, and the district's worst drunks quietly started crossing to the other side.
{name} turned away three troublemakers with a single raised eyebrow apiece.
The house stayed peaceful all week. {name} would call that a good week.

job_madame._note: Weekly report line for a madame.
_default: {name} ran {house} like clockwork and kept everyone's schedules sane.
{name} smoothed over two complaints and a near-duel. Business as usual.
{name} checked in on every lady at least once this week. They noticed.
{name} ran the books at {house}, soothed a nervous client, and still found time to fix a loose hinge.
{name} walked the halls of {house} with her ledger under one arm, quietly deciding who needed a day off.
A week of schedules and gentle word-smithing: {name} kept the ladies happy and the books balanced.
{name} stared down a rude patron without raising her voice. The house is still talking about it.
{name} sorted out the week's rosters over tea and made sure every lady got her proper rest.
{name} greeted important clients at {house} with exactly the right amount of warmth and gave nothing away.

job_rest._note: Weekly report line for a lady resting.
_default: {name} took the week off: long baths, long naps, and a book she's been meaning to finish.
{name} slept in every day this week and regrets nothing.
{name} spent her week off wandering the market and came back with snacks for everyone.
{name} spent her week off in a hammock with a stack of novels and a bowl of dried plums.
{name} walked the riverbank, fed the ducks, and slept without once checking the time.
{name} napped through the afternoons, ate way too many sweet buns, and came back refreshed.
{name} took the week to herself: a long soak, a new hair ribbon, and no one needing anything.
{name} visited the market, bought a ridiculous hat, and wore it proudly all week.
{name} did absolutely nothing for seven days and plans to do it again.

job_rest_demon._note: Weekly report line for a resting demon. Demons don't recover from sleep: on a week off they slip out and feed on men in town.
_default: {name} took the week off, which for a demon means slipping out after dark and feeding on whichever men in town looked at her twice. She came back glowing.
{name} spent her week off in the taverns across town, sipping on strangers. Nobody she fed on remembers her name, which is the point.
{name} rested the demon way: a different tavern every night, a different admirer, and back home by dawn, much less hungry.
{name} spent her week off slipping through back streets after midnight, taking small sips from the men who followed her smile. She was back by dawn, rosy and well fed.
{name} rested the demon way: a quiet tavern, a fresh stranger each evening, and a tiny, delicious taste of each. She came home sated and very sleepy.
{name} drifted across town under the moon, nibbling on affections that no one will miss. She returned humming.
{name} wandered through three taverns, charmed a dozen admirers, and left each with a lingering shiver and no memory of why.
{name} spent her week off feasting politely on strangers' attention, then curled up in her room to digest.
{name} roamed the night markets until her hunger quieted and her cheeks turned warm again.

rest_demon_drain._note: A restless demon overdid it feeding in town on her week off (town reputation loss).
_default: A dockhand she fed on had to be carried home. People are talking.
One of her admirers in town fainted in the street. Word got around about where she works.
She left a guardsman too dizzy to stand. That will be told around town for weeks.

job_promoter._note: Weekly report line for a promoter (no samples).
_default: {name} stood at the door of {house} all week, handing out flyers and smiling at everyone who slowed down.
{name} struck up conversations with half the street. A few of them even came inside.
{name} learned which tavern crowds are worth chatting up and which are just looking for a free drink.
{name} stood in the busiest corner of the market handing out flyers for {house}, with a smile bright enough to catch the eye of a passing cart driver.
{name} chatted up a table of tired caravan guards and left them curious about {house}.
{name} haunted the taverns around {house}, charming strangers with a story and a flyer.
A weekend of flyers, handshakes, and a lot of walking: {name} counted her blisters and her new faces.
{name} found the best spot beside the fountain and spoke warmly of {house} to anyone who slowed their steps.
{name} tried three different pitches this week and discovered the one that works best is simply 'come in, it's warm'.

job_promoter_samples._note: Weekly report line for a promoter handing out free samples.
_default: {name} handed out little teasers all week and left a trail of curious faces in her wake.
{name} gave away a lot of smiles and a few sample tastes. The queue at {house} grew.
{name} made the free samples sound irresistible. They were not wrong.
{name} passed out sample tastes at street corners all week, and curious men followed her like ducklings.
{name} left a trail of blushing, wide-eyed strangers across the market, all with a card for {house} in hand.
{name} gave out generous little teasers all week and watched the line outside {house} grow.
A sample here, a wink there: {name} worked the streets until her feet hurt and the queue at {house} stretched down the lane.
{name} introduced half the district to a very small taste of what {house} offers. They came back for the rest.
{name} hurried back to {house} every evening to catch her breath and count the new faces she'd brought.

job_attendant._note: Weekly report line for an attendant.
_default: {name} kept the corridors of {house} moving: towels, wine, and a calm word when it was needed.
{name} spent the week making the courtesans' evenings easier. Nobody had to ask twice.
{name} refilled glasses, fetched shawls, and noticed everything.
{name} moved through {house} on quiet feet, carrying warm towels, cool water, and exactly what was needed before it was asked for.
{name} kept the rooms of {house} stocked, the sheets fresh, and the courtesans in good spirits.
A week of trays, shawls, and discreet knocks: {name} made every lady's night easier.
{name} knew which lady needed tea, which needed silence, and which needed a hairpin. She was right every time.
{name} dashed up and down the stairs of {house} with towels over her arm and never once dropped a thing.
{name} worked the corridors of {house} quietly, and by midweek the courtesans were saving her the good biscuits.

job_host._note: Weekly report line for a host.
_default: {name} kept the lounge of {house} lively: stories, refilled glasses, and a warm smile for everyone waiting.
{name} made sure nobody waited alone at {house}. Conversation came easily to her.
{name} spent the week charming the guests in the lounge, one more round and one more story at a time.
{name} greeted every guest at {house} like an old friend, remembered names, and had someone laughing in every corner.
{name} drifted around the lounge of {house} with a tray and a warm word, and nobody sat alone for more than a minute.
{name} traded gossip and compliments with half the lounge at {house}, and the evening felt a little warmer for it.
{name} spent the week introducing shy clients to each other, and to the ladies, and to the plum wine.
A talkative week for {name}: stories, toasts, and a shrewd eye for who needed a refill.
{name} kept the lounge at {house} bright and loud, and sent every client off with a smile.

job_courtesan._note: Weekly report line for a courtesan who had no clients.
_default: A quiet week for {name}. She wrote letters and rearranged her room twice.
{name} waited in the lounge all week. The clients simply did not come.
{name} spent a slow week brushing her hair, tuning her instrument, and watching the stairs. The bell stayed quiet.
Not a single knock on {name}'s door all week. She read three books and finished a very long scarf.
{name} dressed up every evening and waited in the lounge, but the clients walked past. She's started naming the cushions.
{name} kept her best smile polished all week. The clients simply never came to use it.
The lounge was almost empty this week, and {name} played cards with the cook to pass the hours.
A drizzly, empty week for {name}. She watched rain on the window and wrote a few lines of poetry she won't show anyone.

job_samples_rep_good._note: Note when a promoter's samples raised the house's name.
_default: {name}'s samples had the whole district talking about {house}.
{name}'s street samples were a hit; people were whispering about {house} in every tavern from the harbor to the hill.
{name} left such a lovely impression that strangers began asking after {house} by name.
The samples {name} gave out were charming and tasteful, and the buzz around {house} grew all week.
{name}'s teasers made the market giggle and the district curious. {house} came out sparkling.
Everyone who met {name} on the street had a good word for {house} afterward.
{name} handled her samples with such style that {house} now has a reputation to live up to.

job_samples_rep_bad._note: Note when a promoter's samples cheapened the house.
_default: {name}'s samples left people shrugging. {house} looked a little cheaper for it.
{name}'s street samples came off as hurried and a little tacky, and {house} paid for it in whispers.
A few people who met {name} on the street came away unimpressed, and {house} slipped in their opinion.
{name}'s samples left a few eyebrows raised, and not in a good way. {house} looks a little cheaper this week.
The samples {name} gave out got more shrugs than smiles, and {house} felt it.
Folk on the street weren't charmed by {name}'s samples, and {house} took a small blow to its name.
{name} meant well, but the samples fell flat, and {house} looks a bit tawdry for it.

rooms_short._note: Note: the house ran out of room sessions.
_default: {house} ran short on rooms this week. More bedrooms would have meant more clients.
{house} turned away guests at the door this week. There simply weren't enough rooms to go around.
The lounge at {house} overflowed with hopeful clients while every bedroom stayed occupied. More rooms would have meant more coin.
Clients lined the hallway of {house}, waiting for a room that never opened. A few gave up and went elsewhere.
Every bed in {house} was in use, and the line kept growing. Sam noted that it's a good problem to have.
{house} ran out of rooms before the evening was half over, and a good number of disappointed guests left.
The ladies of {house} had willing clients and nowhere to take them. More bedrooms would have helped a lot.

tidy_high._note: Weekly note when the house is spotless.
_default: {house} is spotless, and everyone seems to breathe easier for it.
{house} gleams from floor to rafters this week, and even the cat looks smug about it.
The floors of {house} shine, the lanterns are polished, and guests keep commenting on how fresh it all smells.
{house} has never looked better. The ladies breathe easier, and the guests linger.
Every corner of {house} sparkles. It feels like a home you'd be proud to bring a friend to.
Fresh linens, swept floors, and not a cobweb in sight. {house} is a pleasure to walk through.
The whole of {house} is spotless, and the staff look pleased with themselves.

tidy_low._note: Weekly note when the house is getting shabby.
_default: {house} is getting untidy. Guests have noticed, and so have the ladies.
{house} has a few cobwebs in the corners, and the rugs have seen better days. The ladies have started to sigh.
Dust has settled on the banister at {house}, and a guest was seen wiping his hands.
A few too many cups left out and a few too many scuffs on the floors: {house} is slipping.
The lounge at {house} isn't quite as tidy as it used to be. Regulars have started to raise an eyebrow.
{house} is starting to look tired, with smudged windows and a sticky table or two.
Nothing dire yet, but {house} could use a good scrub before it gets worse.

tidy_bad._note: Weekly note when the house is a mess.
_default: {house} is a mess. Guests wrinkle their noses and the ladies are miserable.
{house} is in a sorry state: sticky floors, dusty corners, and a smell that follows people up the stairs.
Guests at {house} step carefully around the mess, and the ladies have begun to grumble loudly.
Dirty plates, tangled linens, and cobwebs the size of handkerchiefs: {house} is a disgrace this week.
The state of {house} has become a topic of conversation, and none of it is flattering.
{house} is filthy. A regular wrote it a polite complaint in the guest book, and then a less polite one.
There is mud on the stairs and a mystery stain on the rug at {house}. Nobody wants to be the one to ask.

bath_massage._note: Weekly line for a bath attendant who gave massages.
_default: {name} offered every bather a massage, and most of them said yes.
{name} wandered among the bathers with warm oil on her palms, offering shoulder rubs to anyone who looked tense, which was everyone.
{name} turned the bath into an assembly line of contented sighs, one pair of shoulders after another.
{name} kneaded knots out of grateful guests while the steam curled around the lanterns.
{name} offered massages at the poolside all week, and the line for her corner of the bath ran out the door.
{name} worked her thumbs into tired necks and sore backs, and a dozen men left a little taller.
{name} dipped her hands in cedar oil and gave the bathhouse its best week yet.

sample_act._note: Report highlight for one free sample a promoter gave on the street ({act} = the service, {lady} = 'offered a massage' style phrase).
_default: {name} pulled a curious passer-by into a doorway near {house} and {lady}, free of charge, then pressed a card into his hand.
Out on the street, {name} gave one hesitant man a free sample: she {lady}, then pointed him at {house}'s door.
{name}'s free sample of the week: a quick {act} in the shadow of {house}'s lanterns. He was inside within the hour.
On a market corner with the noodle stalls steaming behind them, {name} drew a startled stranger aside and {lady}, free of charge, then tucked a card for {house} into his pocket.
{name} waited until the lanterns came on, then gave a lone traveller a free sample: she {lady}. He looked at the card for {house} the whole way to the door.
Beneath a tavern awning, {name} treated one cheerful drunk to a quick {act} and a wink. He staggered off toward {house} to see about the rest.
A sample for the road, {name} decided. A brief, teasing {act} in the alley behind the tea shop, and a man very sure of where he was headed afterward.
Between two rain showers, {name} caught a damp, lonely-looking man by the bridge and {lady}, a free taste. He asked for directions to {house} twice.
{name} gave away one {act} outside the cobbler's, with an audience of exactly one pigeon. The man it went to has been telling people about {house} ever since.
